Both groupoid capitals and their low 1 indices, both G primes, apostrophes and question punctuation were checked. No additional operation or omitted clause was inferred.

The prefix is live above the start of bitorseur. Its low 1 and one hyphen are visible. Proposed finding 2 reproduces the hook-shaped insertion guide, distinct from the mathematical letter and from the b.

The B has a low g, followed by two dark, low spots and an open inclusion sign. Both primed rounded group letters remain locally compatible with E/Sigma. The prose reads image inv. de g par; inv. is an abbreviation and its point is visible. The final horizontal connector has a dark tiny endpoint that does not securely decide a bare stroke versus a minute arrowhead. G and its high prime are separate.

The crossed t and following low exit establish note, and the following strokes read que l’on a; no hyp. is present. The enclosure really opens with a round parenthesis and closes with a right square bracket. The text reads grâce à l’op. de the primed rounded group sur the tilde-X-prime object. The argument is a barred capital I, retained literally; it is not regularised to J. Its cover tilde and prime are independent marks.

The two covers are tilde-X-prime(gj) and tilde-X-prime(j). Wave and bar make the isomorphism sign. The wedge is on the formula baseline; pi-one is below and to its right. B has a heavily retraced low g, still compatible with the definition and lower-row g. No distinct deleted character is separable.

The two covers have high X-primes and j-primes in the arguments gj-prime and j-prime. Both cover tildes are separate from the relation wave. The pi-one is again below/right of its wedge, not superscript. The final B has a clear low g, with its loop and long return.
